Button:
<script setup lang="ts">
interface IButton {
    disabled?: boolean
    animate?: string
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<IButton>(), {
    animate: 'hover:opacity-55 disabled:opacity-20 duration-200 transition-opacity',
})

const emit = defineEmits(['click'])
</script>
<template>
    <button
        :disabled="disabled"
        @click="emit('click')"
        class="w-fit rounded-full disabled:opacity-20"
        :class="{
            [animate]: !disabled,
        }"
    >
        <slot />
    </button>
</template>
